items.canonicalEnglishName: Quinoa, rinsed and drained
items.notes: Quinoa is only rinsed and drained, with no soaking interval or cooking stated. Use uncooked quinoa, not cooked quinoa or quinoa pasta; this does not authorize using cooked or water-retaining mass as dry grain mass.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Rocket, washed two or three times and roughly chopped
items.notes: Rocket/arugula is washed and roughly chopped, with no dressing or cooking. Use raw arugula, not another lettuce or a prepared salad; repeated washing does not establish a mass conversion.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Small fennel bulb, trimmed and thinly sliced
items.notes: Fennel bulb is cleaned, trimmed and diced/sliced without cooking. Use raw fennel bulb, not fennel seed or wild fennel foliage. No trimming yield, cut-size mass or seed-to-bulb substitution.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Small shallot, cleaned and finely chopped
items.notes: Shallot is cleaned and finely chopped, without frying. Use raw shallot rather than onion, freeze-dried shallot or fried shallot; do not infer a small-shallot mass.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Soy sprouts
items.notes: Soy sprouts explicitly identify sprouted soybeans. Use raw sprouted mature soybeans rather than mung-bean sprouts, dried soybeans or cooked sprouts; no germination or water-retention yield is inferred.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Sugar snap peas, strings removed
items.notes: Mangetout/snow peas/sugar-snap peas are edible-podded peas, raw with washing, cutting or string removal only. Use generic raw edible-podded peas rather than shelled mature peas, frozen peas or boiled peas. No exact cultivar or trimming-yield claim.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Swede, peeled and cut into 2 cm-thick pieces
items.notes: Swede cut into pieces is raw rutabaga. Use the rutabaga reference, not ordinary turnip or cooked swede; cut thickness does not determine edible mass.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Sweet Cévennes onion, peeled and chopped
items.notes: Sweet bulb onions, peeled and chopped or sliced only, match the raw sweet-onion reference. Do not substitute cooked onion, onion powder or ordinary spring-onion foliage; no peeling yield or cultivar-specific composition is claimed.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Sweet onion, peeled and chopped

items.canonicalEnglishName: Sweet red paprika
items.notes: Paprika is the single ground sweet-red-pepper spice. Use generic dry paprika, not fresh pepper flesh, chili-powder blend, pepper paste or smoked seasoning; no cultivar-specific nutrient precision is claimed.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Turnip(s), peeled and finely diced (optional)
items.notes: Turnip root, peeled and cut/sliced only, matches generic raw turnips. Optional wording and purple exterior do not turn this into greens or cooked turnip. No piece-weight or peeling-yield conversion is introduced.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Washed and coarsely chopped kale
items.notes: Cavolo nero/kale leaves, washed and chopped only, match generic raw kale. The stated alternative is within kale, not a different food. Do not use cooked or frozen kale; no cultivar-specific nutrients or trimming yield are asserted.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Whole cumin seeds
items.notes: Cumin seed, including its ground form, is the single dry spice specified. Use the retained cumin-seed reference; grinding is not a change to a curry blend or a cooked preparation. No spoon or seed-count mass conversion is implied.

nutritionScope: Generic per-100-g ingredient estimates; not exact cultivar, brand, yield, mass, salt-status or consumption evidence. No inferred density, piece weight, drying yield or cooking conversion.
